headline: Eagles Seek First Win Against Rising Buffaloes
subhead: Boston College travels to Colorado hoping to reverse an 0-2 start against a 1-1 squad riding a blowout victory.

xFactor.why: Roger Anderson ranks third in the PCFL with 662 passing yards and six touchdowns through two games.

keyMatchup: Colorado's seventh-ranked offense averaging 410 yards per game tests a Boston College defense surrendering 406.5 yards per game.
body: Boston College arrives at 0-2 after a one-point loss to Alabama, with the offense managing 323.5 yards per game (16th in the PCFL) and the defense allowing 406.5 yards per game (12th). The Eagles lean on rusher Bo MacCormick, who sits sixth in the league with 107 yards, while averaging just 20 points per game against 25 allowed.

Colorado enters 1-1 following a 42-28 win over Georgia, powered by the PCFL's seventh-ranked offense at 410 yards per game, including 323.5 through the air. Roger Anderson's 662 passing yards and six touchdowns lead a unit complemented by Benjamin Sweeney's 105 rushing yards and Jayden B Skeete's 115 receiving yards, while the defense yields 408.5 yards per game (13th) but features Shilo Sanders with an interception and Jayden B Fry with a sack.
